metadata.description: Extreme Programming disciplines for Claude Code — TDD, exploratory testing, pairing, simple design, planning, and continuous integration, written to hold the line against an LLM's specific failure modes.

plugins.name: xp-testing
plugins.description: The testing disciplines: red-green-refactor as an enforced loop, and chartered exploratory testing that tries to break what the tests already cover.

plugins.name: xp-pairing
plugins.description: The pairing stance — intellectual honesty and ping-pong handoff. Foundational; pairs well with every other XP plugin.

plugins.name: xp-planning
plugins.description: Thin vertical story slicing, time-boxed spikes, and a scored, ranked backlog — well-shaped, well-ordered work before the TDD loop.

plugins.name: xp-integration
plugins.description: Continuous-integration hygiene: small commits, full suite before every commit, never commit red.
